data_fields.name: rearm_below_level
data_fields.donor_constant: donor re-arms at the same 0.20; sketch uses 0.12 (fix D1)

best_idea: A loop whose volume follows a 0..1 intensity, plus one-shot attack and release cues on crossings of a trigger level, with a re-arm band below the trigger so jitter cannot retrigger them.
decision_why: Edge-plus-sustain shape fits charge, guard-hold and stamina-drain cues; the one-threshold re-arm defect is fixed with a 0.12 band; the twelve-direction RCS layout is rejected as having no duel counterpart.
acceptance: A client-only test feeds the level sequence 0, 0.25, 0.15, 0.25, 0.05 and asserts one attack (at 0.25) and one release (at 0.05), with no release at 0.15; a sequence that never reaches 0.20 asserts no attack and no release.
